editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood Italian gem with an elegant, welcoming atmosphere where fresh-ingredient cooking and attentive service make every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Start with the hot rolls and herbed olive oil to awaken your palate, then order the fettuccine alfredo with chicken and broccoli or linguine carbonara—and ask to sit by the French doors that open to the sidewalk when weather permits.
signatureDishes: Fettuccine Alfredo with Chicken and Broccoli
